profile.summary: A firsthand daily field log documenting operational conditions and air quality measurements within two occupied offices in Oregon during January 2025. The text explicitly states that the findings are not claimed to generalize beyond the specific offices and dates recorded.

Analyzing the relationship between humidity levels and K2 filter efficacy under smoke alert conditions
Verifying firsthand accounts of air quality interventions in confined spaces
